• 你在法术持续时间内控制自身5里范围内的天气状况。施展该法术时你必须身处户外，而一旦移动到无法直接看到天空的地点时，法术也会随即终止。
• 本来由DM基于季节和气候所决定的天气状况，在你施展此法术时可以由你随意操控。你可以改变降水、气温以及风势等状况。新的天气状况生效需要经过1d410分钟的时间才能完成。状况改变完成后，你可以再次对当前对天气状况作改变。法术终止时，天气将渐渐恢复成平常状态。
• 改变天气状况时，你可以从以下表格查明与目前对应的等级，再选择同一表格中高一级或低一级的状况作为其改变结果。改变风势时，你还可以同时改变其风向。

降水Precipitation 
等级 状况 
1    天晴clear 
2    薄云light clouds 
3    多云overcast或有雾ground fog 
4    下雨rain，下冰雹hail或下雪snow 
5    暴雨torrential rain，大冰雹driving hail或暴雪blizzard 
气温Temperature 
等级 状况 
1    酷热unbearable heat 
2    炎热hot 
3    暖和warm 
4    清凉cool 
5    寒冷cold 
6    严寒arctic cold 
风势Wind 
等级 状况 
1    无风calm 
2    和风moderate wind 
3    强风strong wind 
4    狂风gale 
5    暴风strom
target:
• You control the weather within 5 li of yourself for the spell's duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and the spell ends immediately if you move somewhere from which you cannot directly see the sky.
• Weather conditions normally determined by the DM according to the season and climate can be manipulated as you wish when you cast this spell. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d410 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once that change is complete, you can change the current weather again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.
• When changing the weather, find the stage corresponding to the current conditions in the tables below, then choose conditions one stage higher or lower in the same table as the result. When changing the wind, you can also change its direction.

Precipitation
Stage  Conditions
1    Clear
2    Light clouds
3    Overcast or ground fog
4    Rain, hail, or snow
5    Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard
Temperature
Stage  Conditions
1    Unbearable heat
2    Hot
3    Warm
4    Cool
5    Cold
6    Arctic cold
Wind
Stage  Conditions
1    Calm
2    Moderate wind
3    Strong wind
4    Gale
5    Storm
note: M484, Player's Handbook, level 8. Complete weather procedure and all 16 stage rows retained. The source's bare li unit and malformed 1d410 timing are preserved without conversion or an invented multiplication sign. The printed English typo strom is preserved in this review note only; the target table uses Storm, matching the explicit Chinese condition. Phase 19 root and independent review: The Chinese condition unambiguously means Storm. Remove the review annotation from the player-facing table and preserve the misspelled source English in the review note only. This does not repair the separate damaged numeric expression or convert li.

• 该法术在施法距离内以你选择的一点为圆心创造一个球形范围。该圆形半径至多为40尺。区域内充斥着魔法黑暗与毁灭性的重力能量。
• 法术持续时间内，球形区域内视为困难地形。一个拥有黑暗视觉的生物没法看透这片魔法黑暗，非魔法的光源无法点亮这片区域。该区域内没法发出声音，声音也没办法穿过该区域。任何完全处于该区域内的生物或物件免疫雷鸣伤害，并且生物完全处于该区域内时处于耳聋状态。在该法术的影响范围内没有办法施展需要语言成分的法术。
• 任何在自己回合中第一次进入该区域的生物或在该区域内开始其回合的生物需要进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，该生物受到8d10点力场伤害，成功则只受到一半伤害。当一个生物的HP被该法术降低到0时，该生物被解离。被解离的生物与其身上穿着的，携带着的一切，除了魔法物品外，都会化为一缕灰色的烟尘。
target:
• This spell creates a sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Its radius is up to 40 feet. The area is filled with magical darkness and destructive gravitational energy.
• For the spell's duration, the sphere is difficult terrain. A creature with darkvision cannot see through this magical darkness, and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it. Sound cannot be produced inside the area or pass through it. Any creature or object entirely inside the area is immune to thunder damage, and creatures entirely inside it are deafened. Spells that require verbal components cannot be cast within the spell's area.
• Any creature that enters the area for the first time on its own turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d10 force damage, or half as much on a success. A creature whose HP is reduced to 0 by this spell is disintegrated. The disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing or carrying, except magic items, become a wisp of gray dust.
note: M485, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, level 8. Retains the source's own-turn entry trigger, entirely-inside qualifications for immunity/deafness, component restriction, and disintegration exception; no different-edition wording was substituted.

• 你在施法距离内一处能看见的平面上创造一扇形状模糊的门。门的大小足以让中型生物在其间通行无阻。门开启时，其通向一个边长30尺，由木质或石质组成的空房间半位面。法术终止时，门消失不见，而半位面中的门也消失不见，并把任何还在半位面的生物或物件困在其内。
• 你每次施展此法术时都可以创造一个新的半位面，也可以连向用此法术创造的旧有的半位面。另外，如果你知晓了某个其他生物用此法术创造的半位面，则你也可以通过此法术连接到那里。
target:
• You create an indistinct door on a flat surface you can see within range. The door is large enough for a Medium creature to pass through freely. When opened, it leads to a demiplane consisting of an empty room made of wood or stone, 30 feet on each side. When the spell ends, the door disappears, as does the door inside the demiplane, trapping any creatures or objects still inside.
• Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect to an existing demiplane created with this spell. Also, if you know of a demiplane another creature created with this spell, you can use this spell to connect to it.
note: M486, Player's Handbook, level 8. Translates the actual source's knowledge requirement for another creature's demiplane; does not add a remembered contents/nature prerequisite absent from this cell.

• 你试图安抚一个施法距离内你能看见的生物，必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则将在法术持续时间内被你魅惑。若它正与你或你的友方生物战斗，则其进行该豁免时具有优势。
• 该生物被魅惑时，只要你与其处于同一位面就可以与之保持心灵感应。你在有意识时，可以通过心灵感应命令该生物（不需要作动作），而它则会尽量服从。你可以描述一个简单具体的行为指令，比如“攻击那个生物”“跑到那个位置”或是“去拿那个物品”。生物完成一项指令却未收到你的进一步指示时，将会使用其本身的能力尽可能的保护自己。
• 你可以使用动作以彻底而精确的控制目标。而该生物则只能作你选择的动作，且不能作任何你没有允许的动作，并持续至你下回合结束。在此期间，你还可以要求该生物作一个反应，但这需要你使用自己的反应来实现。
• 每次目标受到伤害时，都可以尝试进行一次感知豁免，豁免成功则法术终止。
• 升环施法效应：使用9环法术位施展该法术时，持续时间变为：专注，至多8小时。
target:
• You attempt to pacify a creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If it is fighting you or creatures friendly to you, it has advantage on this save.
• While the creature is charmed, you maintain a telepathic connection with it as long as you are on the same plane. While conscious, you can use this connection to give it commands without taking an action, and it does its best to obey. You can describe a simple, specific course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run to that location," or "Fetch that item." If the creature completes an order without receiving further instructions, it uses its abilities to protect itself as best it can.
• You can use an action to take complete and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature can take only the actions you choose and cannot take any action you have not allowed. During this time, you can also make it take a reaction, but doing so requires you to use your own reaction.
• Each time the target takes damage, it can attempt a Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell on a success.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, the duration becomes Concentration, up to 8 hours.
note: M487, Player's Handbook, level 8. All command, precise-control, reaction-cost, damage-save, and upcasting conditions retained. The source's optional damage-triggered save is not silently replaced with another formulation.

• 你在施法距离内一处能看见的地面上指定一点，并在其上制造地震扰动。在法术持续时间内，一阵强烈的震颤在震源周边半径100尺的圆形范围内传递，并使区域内地上的生物和建筑都受到震动影响。
• 受影响区域内的地面变为困难地形。而区域地面上的每个正在进行专注的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则其专注被打断。
• 在你施展此法术以及随后保持专注的每回合结束时，区域地面上的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则生物应击倒地。
• 根据施法区域的地形，DM可以决定是否应用额外的效应。
• 裂缝 Fissures：在施展此法术的下一个回合开始时，法术影响区域会撕开一道道裂缝。1d6条裂缝在DM安排的位置出现。每条裂缝深1d1010尺，宽10尺，并由影响区域的一边向另一边延伸。裂缝撕开时，将处于其位置上的生物必须成功通过一次敏捷豁免，否则将坠落其中。豁免成功则该生物移动到裂缝旁边。
• 裂缝上的建筑会直接崩塌，详情如下。
• 建筑 Structures：在你施展此法术及法术终止前你的每个回合开始时，地震对影响区域内的所有建筑都造成50点钝击伤害。建筑生命值降为0时立即崩塌，且可能对附近生物造成伤害。与该建筑距离不大于该建筑高度一半的生物，都必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败则受5d6点钝击伤害并应击倒地且埋于废墟之下。该生物可用一个动作来进行一次DC20的力量（运动）检定来尝试逃离废墟。DM可根据废墟的情况调整DC高低。豁免成功时伤害减半，且不会倒地或被掩埋。
target:
• You choose a point on the ground that you can see within range and create a seismic disturbance there. For the spell's duration, an intense tremor spreads through a circular area with a 100-foot radius around that point, shaking creatures and structures on the ground in the area.
• The ground in the affected area becomes difficult terrain. Each creature on that ground that is concentrating must make a Constitution saving throw, losing concentration on a failed save.
• When you cast this spell and at the end of each subsequent turn during which you maintain concentration, each creature on the ground in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, falling prone on a failed save.
• Depending on the terrain in the spell's area, the DM can decide whether to apply additional effects.
• Fissures: At the start of the turn after you cast this spell, fissures tear open in the affected area. 1d6 fissures appear in locations chosen by the DM. Each fissure is 1d1010 feet deep and 10 feet wide, extending from one side of the affected area to the other. A creature in a fissure's location when it opens must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall into it. On a success, the creature moves to the side of the fissure.
• A structure over a fissure collapses immediately, as described below.
• Structures: When you cast this spell and at the start of each of your turns before it ends, the earthquake deals 50 bludgeoning damage to every structure in the affected area. A structure collapses immediately when its hit points reach 0 and can damage nearby creatures. A creature whose distance from the structure is no greater than half the structure's height must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and is buried in the rubble. The creature can use an action to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to escape the rubble. The DM can adjust the DC according to the nature of the rubble. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is neither knocked prone nor buried.
note: M488, Player's Handbook, level 8. Complete ground, concentration, fissure, and structure rules retained, including the distinct end-of-turn and start-of-turn timings. The damaged source expression 1d1010 feet is preserved literally; no multiplication operator was inferred.

source:
• 指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物，并尝试摧毁其理智与人格。目标受4d6点心灵伤害且须进行一次智力豁免。
• 豁免失败时，该生物的智力和魅力变为1。受术生物将不能施法，也不能启动魔法物品，甚至不能听懂语言或以智慧方式沟通。但该生物仍可以辨识、跟随伙伴，甚至保护他们。
• 受术生物每过30日即可在当日结束时重新进行一次豁免，豁免成功则该法术效应终止。
• 另外，高等复原术 Greater Restoration，医疗术 Heal或者许愿术 Wish可直接终止该法术的效应。
target:
• Choose a creature you can see within range and attempt to destroy its intellect and personality. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw.
• On a failed save, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma become 1. The affected creature cannot cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate intelligently. It can still recognize and follow its companions, and even protect them.
• After every 30 days, the affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of that day, ending the spell's effect on a success.
• Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish can also end the spell's effect directly.
note: M489, Player's Handbook, level 8. Preserves damage before the save, both ability reductions, recognition exception, the end-of-day repeat-save timing, and all three named remedies.

source: • 神圣的光芒从你身体中奔涌而出，在你身边汇聚成半径30尺的柔光。施展该法术时，你指定处于柔光范围内的若干生物。被指定生物散发出半径5尺的微光光照，且其进行的所有豁免均具有优势，而其他生物对它们进行的攻击检定具有劣势。该效应将持续至法术终止。另外，当一个邪魔或不死生物以近战攻击命中受术生物时，其灵光将产生耀眼的爆发，而攻击者必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败者将陷入目盲直至法术终止。
target: • Divine light pours from your body and gathers in a soft radiance within 30 feet of you. When you cast this spell, choose creatures within that radiance. The chosen creatures shed dim light in a 5-foot radius and have advantage on all saving throws, while other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. This effect lasts until the spell ends. In addition, when a fiend or undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, that creature's aura bursts with dazzling light. The attacker must make a Constitution saving throw, becoming blinded until the spell ends on a failed save.
note: M491, Player's Handbook, level 8. Preserves selection at casting, both radii, all-save and incoming-attack effects, and the fiend/undead melee-hit blindness branch. Does not add an unstated target count.

source:
• 你汇聚、编织从堕影冥界收集的阴影物质，随后在施法距离内你可见的未占据空间创造出巨型阴影龙。这个幻象会占据所在空间并持续到法术结束，就好像是一个真实生物。
• 当幻象出现时，任何可以看见幻象的你的敌人必须成功进行感知豁免检定，否则将在1分钟内陷入恐惧。如果被恐惧的生物在与幻象没有视觉线相连的位置并结束回合，它可以重新进行豁免检定，成功将终止对自己的恐惧效果。
• 在你的回合中以一个附赠动作，你可以移动幻象最多60尺。选择它进行移动的任意一点，你可以使它以那个位置作为起源点并喷吐出60尺锥形的爆发性能量。在你创造巨龙时选择一种伤害类型：强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电，黯蚀或者毒素。处于锥形范围内的每个生物必须进行智力豁免检定，若豁免失败会受到7d6点对应类型的伤害，成功只承受一半。
• 幻象是有形的因为它由阴影物质创造而成，不过对它的攻击会自动失手。它会通过所有豁免检定，并且免疫所有的伤害和异常状态。一个生物可以用动作来进行智力（调查）检定对抗你的法术豁免DC来判断巨龙是否为幻影。如果生物识别了幻象的真相，生物可以看穿它并在对抗它的吐息时获得优势。
context: column:M;spell:Illusory Dragon;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• You gather and weave shadow material collected from the Shadowfell, then create a Huge shadow dragon in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The illusion occupies its space and lasts until the spell ends, as though it were a real creature.
• When the illusion appears, any of your enemies that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. If a frightened creature ends its turn in a location with no line of sight to the illusion, it can repeat the save, ending the frightened effect on itself on a success.
• As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point along its movement, you can have it breathe a 60-foot cone of explosive energy originating from that location. Choose a damage type when you create the dragon: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or poison. Each creature in the cone must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 7d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
• The illusion is tangible because it is made from shadow material, but attacks against it automatically miss. It succeeds on all saving throws and is immune to all damage and conditions. A creature can use an action to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to determine whether the dragon is an illusion. If it recognizes the illusion for what it is, it can see through the dragon and has advantage against its breath.
note: M492, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 8. Full frightened-repeat-save and moving breath branches retained, including all six damage types. The source's final advantage wording is left broad ('against its breath') rather than adding a missing save qualifier from memory.

source:
• 一片充满了炽热灰烬的旋转烟云显现，并以施法距离内一点为中心的蔓延至半径20尺的球状区域。烟云会绕过拐角扩散并使整个区域处于重度遮蔽，并在法术终止前持续存在。此外烟云还可以被和风或强度等级更高的风势（风速至少每小时10里）所吹散。
• 烟云出现时，每个处在其内的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到10d8点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。生物在一个回合内第一次进入烟云内，或者在烟云内结束其回合时，也必须进行该豁免。
• 在你的每回合开始时，烟云会向你指定的方向直线移动10尺。
target:
• A swirling cloud of smoke filled with hot embers appears, spreading into a sphere with a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and heavily obscures its entire area, remaining until the spell ends. A moderate or stronger wind, with a speed of at least 10 li per hour, can disperse the cloud.
• When the cloud appears, every creature inside it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature must also make this save when it enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.
• At the start of each of your turns, the cloud moves 10 feet in a straight line in a direction you choose.
note: M493, Player's Handbook, level 8. The bare source unit li is retained for wind speed without assuming miles. Preserves any-turn entry versus own-turn end triggers and the source's freely chosen straight-line direction.

source:
• 魔法黑暗从范围内你指定的一点延伸至半径60尺的球形范围，直到法术结束。黑暗会蔓延过拐角。生物的黑暗视觉不能看穿这片黑暗。非魔法的光源，以及8环和8环以下法术创造的光亮不能照亮这片区域。
• 尖叫声，低语声，以及疯狂的大笑声时不时能从球形范围内听见。每当一名生物在范围内开始回合，它必须进行一次感知豁免，失败时将受到8d8心灵伤害，成功则只承受一半。
context: column:M;spell:Maddening Darkness;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range into a sphere with a 60-foot radius until the spell ends. The darkness spreads around corners. Creatures cannot see through it with darkvision. Nonmagical light and light created by spells of level 8 or lower cannot illuminate the area.
• Screams, whispers, and mad laughter can be heard from the sphere from time to time. Whenever a creature starts its turn in the area, it must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 8d8 psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
note: M494, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 8. Complete light restriction and start-of-turn damage save translated. The source repeats the numeral 8 in its 'level 8 and below level 8' phrasing; the single equivalent English bound 'level 8 or lower' is a documented duplicate-bound normalization.

source:
• 你将施法距离内一个你能看见的生物放逐到一个迷宫般错综复杂的半位面。目标将一直留在该处直至法术持续时间结束，或者直到它逃出该迷宫。
• 目标可以使用其动作尝试逃出迷宫。此时它可以进行一次DC20的智力检定，检定成功者将逃出迷宫，而该法术随之终止。牛头人和巨牛魔进行该检定时直接成功。
• 法术终止时，目标将重新出现在它之前消失的位置。如果该位置被占据，则目标出现在最近的未占据位置。
target:
• You banish a creature you can see within range to a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there until the spell's duration ends or it escapes the maze.
• The target can use its action to try to escape the maze. It can make a DC 20 Intelligence check, escaping the maze and ending the spell on a success. Minotaurs and goristros automatically succeed on this check.
• When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space where it disappeared. If that space is occupied, the target appears in the nearest unoccupied space.
note: M495, Player's Handbook, level 8. Preserves action-based Intelligence check rather than a saving throw, DC 20, automatic success for the two named creatures, and occupied-space fallback.

source:
• 一座岩石的堡垒从施法距离内你选择的一处可见的方形地面升起。这块区域需要在每一边上有至少120尺，并且必须没有任何建筑或其他构造物立于其上。所有处于区域内的生物在堡垒升起时将会被无害地举起。
• 这座堡垒有4个方形的塔楼，每一个都有20尺的边长和30尺的高度，分布在堡垒的每个角上。塔楼通过每边80尺长的石墙相互连接，创造出一个封闭的区域。每一面墙的厚度都达到1尺，由10尺宽度和20尺高度的石板组成。每块石板都与其他两块石板或是与一块石板和一座塔楼相邻接。你可以在堡垒的外墙放置4面石门。
• 在封闭区域内树立着一座小城堡。城堡拥有50尺边长的方形基座，并且有3层楼，每一层的天花板都有10尺高。每一层都可以以你喜欢的方式划分出许多房间，但每个房间都至少要有5尺的边长。城堡的每一层都由石头楼梯相连，它的墙厚达6英寸，室内房间的门户式样（石门或者开放式拱门）由你选择。城堡内部的家具和装潢以你喜欢的方式布置，它每天可以提供足够100人享用的、包含九道菜肴的盛宴。从堡垒中被带走的家具、食物和其他由该法术创造的物体会立即化为土灰。
• 你在施展法术时可以指定任意生物，有100个隐形的侍从作为堡垒的职工遵从他们的任何命令。每一个侍从都如同隐形仆役法术的造物，有近似的功能。
• 所有由石头创造的城墙、塔楼和城堡都会被损害。每一块10尺x10尺的岩石部件都有15点AC，以及每英寸厚度30点的生命值。它免疫毒素和心灵伤害。将某一部分的岩石生命值降低至0点会摧毁它，并且也许会引起与它连接的部分变形和垮塌，具体由你的DM裁量。
• 在7天之后，或当你在别处再次施展该法术，堡垒会无害地坍塌并沉入地面，把其中的任何生物安全地留在地上。
• 在一年之间，每7天一次在相同的位置施展该法术会让堡垒永久存在。
context: column:M;spell:Mighty Fortress;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:8
target:
• A stone fortress rises from a square area of ground you choose and can see within range. The area must measure at least 120 feet on each side and have no buildings or other structures standing on it. All creatures in the area are harmlessly lifted as the fortress rises.
• The fortress has 4 square towers, each 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with one at each corner. Stone walls 80 feet long connect the towers on each side, creating an enclosed area. Each wall is 1 foot thick and consists of panels 10 feet wide and 20 feet high. Each panel adjoins either two other panels or a panel and a tower. You can place 4 stone doors in the fortress's outer walls.
• A keep stands within the enclosed area. It has a square base 50 feet on a side and 3 floors, each with a ceiling 10 feet high. You can divide each floor into rooms however you like, but each room must be at least 5 feet on a side. Stone stairs connect the floors. The keep's walls are 6 inches thick, and you choose the style of the interior doorways: stone doors or open archways. You arrange the interior furnishings and decor as you wish. Each day, it can provide a nine-course feast sufficient for 100 people. Furnishings, food, and other objects created by this spell turn to dust immediately if taken out of the fortress.
• You can designate any creatures when you cast the spell. A staff of 100 invisible servants obeys their commands. Each servant functions much like a creation of the Unseen Servant spell.
• All the stone walls, towers, and the keep can be damaged. Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of stone has AC 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness. It is immune to poison and psychic damage. Reducing a section of stone to 0 hit points destroys it and might cause connected sections to buckle and collapse, as determined by your DM.
• After 7 days, or when you cast this spell again elsewhere, the fortress harmlessly collapses and sinks into the ground, leaving any creatures inside safely on the ground.
• Casting this spell in the same location once every 7 days for a year makes the fortress permanent.
note: M496, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 8. Complete architecture, servants, meals, object removal, section durability, collapse, and permanence rules retained. 'At least 120 feet' follows the actual source. Explicit source inches are translated as inches; no bare-unit assumption is needed. Phase 19 root and independent review: Within the fortress adds a command-location limitation absent from this source sentence. Delete only that phrase; do not add unrestricted travel, change the Unseen Servant comparison, or alter the separate rule for objects taken from the fortress.

source: • 直至法术终止前，你所触碰的一个自愿生物对下列项目具有免疫：心灵伤害；任何可以感知到其情绪或阅读其思想的效应；预言法术；魅惑状态。当目标受祈愿术 Wish或者其他威力相当的法术或效应影响心智或窃获信息时，其也能以该法术进行阻挡。
target: • Until the spell ends, a willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that senses its emotions or reads its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition. This spell also blocks Wish or other spells or effects of comparable power when they would affect the target's mind or obtain information about it.
note: M497, Player's Handbook, level 8. Preserves all four immunity categories and the Wish/comparable-effect protection without adding broader unstated defenses.

source:
• 你说出一蕴含威力的单词，其足以使施法距离内一个你能看见的生物意志受压迫而震惊。如果你所指定的生物现有生命值为150或更少，则其被震慑。否则该法术不产生任何效应。
• 被震慑目标必须在其每回合结束时进行一次体质豁免。豁免成功，则此震慑效果终止。
target:
• You speak a word of power that overwhelms the mind of a creature you can see within range. If the creature you choose currently has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.
• The stunned target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this stunned effect on a success.
note: M498, Player's Handbook, level 8. Preserves the inclusive 150-HP threshold, no-effect branch, and mandatory end-of-turn Constitution save.

source:
• 你将现实与时间线之间的壁垒粉碎，使一个生物陷入混沌与疯狂。目标必须通过一个感知豁免，否则将无法执行任何反应直到法术结束。被影响的生物必须在其回合开始时roll一个d10，其结果决定目标身上发生了什么，参照下方表格“崩坏现实效果”。
• 在其回合结束时，受影响的生物能重复其感知豁免，若成功，则法术结束。

崩坏现实效果
d10   效果
1–2   遥远国度之瞥。目标受到6d12点心灵伤害并且陷入震慑到本轮结束。
3–5   崩碎裂缝。目标必须通过一个敏捷豁免，若失败则受到8d12点力场伤害，若豁免成功则受到一半伤害。
6–8   虫洞。该目标与其身上所着装、携带的一切东西被传送到他30尺内你能看到的未被占据的空间。目标受到12d10点力场伤害并倒地。
9–10   暗虚之冻。 目标受到12d10点冷冻伤害并且目盲到本回合结束。
target:
• You shatter the barriers between reality and timelines, plunging a creature into chaos and madness. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to take reactions until the spell ends. At the start of its turn, an affected creature must roll a d10 to determine what happens to it, using the Reality Break Effects table below.
• At the end of its turn, the affected creature can repeat its Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell on a success.

Reality Break Effects
d10   Effect
1–2   Vision of the Far Realm. The target takes 6d12 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of the current round.
3–5   Rending Rift. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d12 force damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
6–8   Wormhole. The target and everything it is wearing or carrying are teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of it. The target takes 12d10 force damage and falls prone.
9–10   Chill of the Dark Void. The target takes 12d10 cold damage and is blinded until the end of the current turn.
note: M499, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, level 8. Complete four-row d10 table and initial/repeat saves retained. Row 1-2 says end of the current round, whereas row 9-10 says end of the current turn; this source distinction is preserved rather than silently harmonized.

source:
• 灿烂的阳光照耀施法距离内指定的一点为中心周围60尺半径的区域。所有位于该光芒中的生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到12d6点光耀伤害，并陷入1分钟的目盲状态。
• 豁免成功则伤害减半，且不会陷入目盲。不死生物和泥怪进行该豁免时具有劣势。
• 因该法术陷入目盲的生物在其每回合结束时都可以再进行一次体质豁免。豁免成功则不再目盲。
• 该法术将驱散法术区域内所有由法术所创造的黑暗。
target:
• Brilliant sunlight shines in a 60-foot-radius area centered on a point you choose within range. Every creature in the light must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute.
• On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not blinded. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this save.
• A creature blinded by this spell can make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success.
• This spell dispels all darkness created by spells within its area.
note: M500, Player's Handbook, level 8. All damage, blindness, repeat-save, creature-type disadvantage, and magical-darkness dispelling conditions retained.

source:
• 你与一个你熟识的自愿生物建起心灵连接。该生物可以身处你所在的位面的任意位置。一旦你与目标生物不再位于同一位面则该法术随即终止。
• 直至法术终止前，你可以和目标生物通过心灵连接即时共享任何言语、图像、声音以及其他形式的感官信息，而目标也能够辨认出与之交流的对象正是你本人。该法术可以让智力值至少为1的目标生物理解你的言语并接收任何你所发送的感官信息。
target:
• You establish a telepathic connection with a willing creature you know well. The creature can be anywhere on your plane. The spell ends immediately if you and the target are no longer on the same plane.
• Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantly share words, images, sounds, and any other sensory information through the connection. The target recognizes you as the one communicating with it. This spell allows a target with an Intelligence score of at least 1 to understand your words and receive any sensory information you send.
note: M501, Player's Handbook, level 8. Retains willing familiar target, same-plane termination, reciprocal sensory communication, sender recognition, and the inclusive Intelligence 1 threshold.

source:
• 你指定施法距离内一点并从中升起一面水墙。水墙长不过300尺，高不过300尺，厚不过50尺，且持续存在至法术终止。
• 水墙出现时，所有位于水墙内的生物都要进行一次力量豁免。豁免失败者将受到6d10点钝击伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
• 水墙出现后，将在你每一回合开始时带着其内的所有生物一起向远离你的方向移动50尺。当水墙进入一个巨型或更小体型生物所占据空间，或他们原本就处于墙内时，该生物必须进行一次力量豁免，豁免失败则受到5d10点钝击伤害。该伤害一轮里对同一个生物只生效一次。在你的回合结束时，水墙的高度减少50尺，且其随后每轮对生物造成的伤害也减少1d10。当水墙高
度变为0尺时法术终止。
• 淹没在水墙中的生物可以用游泳的方式移动，由于波涛阻力影响，该生物必须要进行一次对抗该法术DC的力量（运动）检定以决定起能否成功移动，而检定失败者则无法移动。通过移动离开水墙区域的生物会直接掉到地上。
target:
• You choose a point within range, and a wall of water rises from it. The wall is no more than 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick, and lasts until the spell ends.
• When the wall appears, every creature inside it must make a Strength saving throw, taking 6d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
• After appearing, the wall moves 50 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, carrying all creatures inside it. When the wall enters the space of a Huge or smaller creature, or such a creature is already inside it, the creature must make a Strength saving throw, taking 5d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure. This damage affects a given creature only once per round. At the end of your turn, the wall's height decreases by 50 feet, and the damage it deals to creatures each subsequent round decreases by 1d10. The spell ends when the wall's height reaches 0 feet.
• A creature engulfed by the wall can move by swimming. Because of the force of the waves, it must make a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell's DC to determine whether it can move successfully. On a failed check, it cannot move. A creature that moves out of the wall's area falls to the ground.
note: M502, Player's Handbook, level 8. Complete movement, initial/later damage, size, once-per-round, shrink, and swimming rules retained. Joins the source's accidental line break inside the word for height; does not add half damage to the later failed-save-only branch.

source:
• 你和施法距离内至多八名自愿的生物将躯体投影到星界（如果你已经在星界，则法术失败且被消耗）。你原本的躯体昏迷并进入静止状态，即其不需要空气和食物也不会衰老。
• 你的星界躯体几乎完美的保持了原本的形态，并保留你本体的游戏资料和随身物。星界躯体和你本体的主要区别是从你肩胛骨间向后伸出的一条银线。这条可见长度仅有一尺的银线是你星界躯体和本体间的联系。只要银线保持完好，你总能找到回原本世界的路。只有明确注明可以切断这种银线的效应才可以将其切断。切断银线会将你的灵魂和躯体分离，并将你杀死。
• 你的星界躯体可以在星界任意旅行，并能穿过星界的传送门到达其他位面。如果你到达一个新位面，或是回到你施法时所在的位面，你的本体和物品将沿着银线被传送，使你以本体的形态到达新位面。你的星界躯体是单独的实体。星界躯体承受的伤害或效应不会反映在你的本体上，也不会在你回到本体时保持。
• 你可以使用一个动作来解散法术，并终止其对你与同伴产生的效应。法术终止时，受术的生物回到其原本的躯体并苏醒。
• 你或你的某位同伴会存在提前终止法术效应的情况。对某生物的本体或星界躯体成功施展解除魔法 Dispel Magic将终止生物的投影效应。如果某生物的本体或星界躯体的生命值降至0，则该生物自身的投影效应终止。如果法术终止时银线依然保持连接，则受术生物会被拉回原本的躯体，并脱离静止状态。
• 如果你在法术终止前被送回本体，你的同伴将被留在星界，只能自行返回（通常通过生命值降至0 的方式）。
target:
• You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your bodies into the Astral Plane. If you are already on the Astral Plane, the spell fails and is expended. Your original body falls unconscious and enters suspended animation: it needs neither air nor food and does not age.
• Your astral body preserves your original form almost perfectly, retaining your original body's game statistics and possessions. The main difference between your astral body and your original body is a silver cord extending from between your shoulder blades. Only one foot of this cord is visible. It connects your astral body to your original body, and as long as it remains intact, you can always find your way back to your original world. Only an effect that explicitly states it can sever such a cord can do so. Severing the cord separates your soul from your body and kills you.
• Your astral body can travel freely through the Astral Plane and pass through astral portals to other planes. If you arrive on a new plane or return to the plane where you cast the spell, your original body and possessions are transported along the silver cord, so that you arrive on the new plane in your original body. Your astral body is a separate entity. Damage or effects it suffers are not reflected in your original body and do not persist when you return to that body.
• You can use an action to dismiss the spell and end its effects on you and your companions. When the spell ends, affected creatures return to their original bodies and awaken.
• The spell's effect can end early for you or one of your companions. A successful Dispel Magic cast on a creature's original or astral body ends its projection. If a creature's original or astral body is reduced to 0 hit points, the projection ends for that creature. If the silver cord is still connected when the spell ends, the affected creature is pulled back to its original body and leaves suspended animation.
• If you are returned to your body before the spell ends, your companions are left on the Astral Plane and must find their own way back, usually by being reduced to 0 hit points.
note: M503, Player's Handbook, level 9. Full projection, silver-cord death, interplanar return, separate-body effects, dismissal, individual termination, and stranded-companion branches translated. Keeps the source's stated air/food requirements without adding a drinking rule.

source:
• 你在法术范围内你能看见的一个未被占据的创造出一把形态如同剑一般的，长约3尺的位面裂缝。该剑刃持续存在，直至法术结束。当你施展此法术时，你可以用该剑刃进行至多两次近战法术攻击，每次攻击的目标为位于剑刃5尺内的一个生物、未被携带的物件或建筑。若命中，则目标受到4d12点力场伤害。该攻击在d20投出18或更高时造成重击，并在重击时造成额外4d12点力场伤害（共计12d12点力场伤害）。
• 你可以在自己回合内以一个附赠动作让该武器移动至多30尺到一个你可以看见的未被占据的空间，随后再用其进行两次近战法术攻击。
• 该剑刃可以无害地通过任何屏障，包括一道力场墙。
context: column:M;spell:Blade of Disaster;book:塔莎的万象坩埚;level:9
target:
• You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade remains until the spell ends. When you cast the spell, you can make up to two melee spell attacks with the blade. Each attack targets a creature, an object that is not being carried, or a structure within 5 feet of the blade. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 force damage. The attack scores a critical hit on a d20 roll of 18 or higher and deals an additional 4d12 force damage on a critical hit, for a total of 12d12 force damage.
• As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, then make two melee spell attacks with it.
• The blade can pass harmlessly through any barrier, including a Wall of Force.
note: M504, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything, level 9. Retains casting-time up-to-two attacks, subsequent two attacks, eligible targets, critical threshold, stated additional 4d12 and total 12d12, and barrier passage. The source's incomplete 'unoccupied' noun phrase is rendered as space, without changing its mechanics.

source:
• 你触碰一个自愿生物，并授予其预示最近未来事件的有限能力。该目标在法术持续时间内无法被突袭，并且其进行的攻击检定、属性检定和豁免检定均具有优势。而其他生物对其进行攻击检定时具有劣势。
• 如果你在法术持续时间结束前再施展该法术，则原法术效应即时终止。
target:
• You touch a willing creature and grant it a limited ability to foresee events in the immediate future. For the spell's duration, the target cannot be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against it.
• If you cast this spell again before its duration ends, the original spell's effect ends immediately.
note: M505, Player's Handbook, level 9. All four target benefits, incoming-attack disadvantage, and recasting termination preserved.

source:
• 你召唤一扇传送门将施法距离内你能看到的一处未被占据空间与一个不同位面的特定地点连接在一起。传送门是你打开的一个直径5到20尺的圆形开口。其开口朝向你指定的任意方向，并持续至法术终止。
• 传送门在某个位面显现时有着明确的正反面。只有从正面穿过传送门的事物才能实现其传送功能，从而传送至另一位面，并在离传送门最近的未占据空间中显现。
• 神祗和其他位面统治者可以阻止该法术在其所在或属于其领域的任何地点创造传送门。
• 施展该法术时，你可以说出某个特定生物的名字（不能是假名、头衔、绰号等）。如果该生物在与你不同的位面，则传送门会紧挨被指名生物打开并将该生物吸进传送门。此时该生物会从你所在的传送门另一头出现，并显现在距传送门最近的未被占据空间。你不会获得任何被传送生物的特殊能力，而它此时可以自由的作任何DM认为合适的行动。它可能离开，也可以攻击你或协助你。
target:
• You conjure a portal connecting an unoccupied space you can see within range to a specific location on a different plane. The portal is a circular opening 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the opening in any direction you choose, and it lasts until the spell ends.
• When the portal appears on a plane, it has a distinct front and back. Only something that passes through its front is transported to the other plane, where it appears in the nearest unoccupied space to the portal.
• Deities and other planar rulers can prevent this spell from creating a portal anywhere in their presence or domains.
• When you cast the spell, you can speak a particular creature's name, which cannot be an alias, title, nickname, or the like. If that creature is on a different plane from you, the portal opens immediately beside it and draws it through. The creature emerges from the other end of the portal on your side, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space to it. You gain none of the transported creature's special abilities, and it is free to act as the DM sees fit. It might leave, attack you, or help you.
note: M506, Player's Handbook, level 9. Retains the source's unexpected sentence that you gain none of the transported creature's special abilities; it was not silently changed to the different concept of authority/control over that creature. All portal orientation, front-side, planar-ruler, and true-name conditions are retained.

• 你创造一个魔法监牢，将施法距离内一个你能看见的生物监禁于其内。目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则被该法术禁锢；对于成功通过豁免的生物，若你再次对其施展该法术，则它对该法术免疫。被该法术禁锢时，目标生物不需要呼吸，不需要吃喝，也不会变老。预言法术也无法定位或感知到该目标。你在施展该法术时从下列选项中选择一种监牢的形式：
• 埋葬 Burial：目标被深埋在远离地表的球状魔法力场内，其大小刚好能包覆住目标。任何事物均无法穿过该力场，且任何生物均无法通过传送或位面旅行进出该力场。（特殊材料为一个秘银小球）
• 锁链 Chaining：沉重的锁链牢固地深植于大地，将目标禁锢在原地。目标被束缚至法术终止，其间它不能移动或以任何方式被移动。（特殊材料为一截精美的贵金属链）
• 避世监牢 Hedged Prison：该法术将目标传送至一个隔绝了传送和位面旅行的小型半位面。该半位面可以是一个迷宫，一间牢房，一座塔楼，或是任意由你选择的幽闭建筑或区域。（特殊材料为一个玉制的监牢微缩模型）
• 微缩牢笼 Minimus Containment：目标被缩小到1寸高，并囚禁于一块宝石或是类似的物件里。光线可以正常地穿透宝石（这让目标可以看到外面，其他生物也可以看到里面），但其他任何事物均无法在其内进出，即使是通过传送或位面旅行等手段也不行。只要法术仍然生效，该宝石就无法被切开或打碎。（特殊材料为一大块透明的宝石，例如刚玉，钻石或红宝石）
• 沉睡 Slumber：目标陷入昏睡且无法被唤醒。（特殊材料为稀有的催眠药草）
• 终止法术：无论是法术的哪个版本，你都可以在施法过程中设定一个使法术终止并释放目标的条件。此条件可以按你的意愿设定其明确或复杂的程度，但必须经由DM认可该条件的合理性及可实现性。此条件可以根据一个生物的名字，身份或神格来设定，但在其他方面必须基于可观察到的行为或特性，而不能基于诸如等级，职业或生命值这类无形之物。
• 法术解除魔法 Dispel Magic可以终止该法术，但只有使用9环法术位并针对监牢或针对创造监牢效果的特殊物质施展时才有效。
• 你在同一时间内，使用同一种特殊材料只能创造一个监牢。如果你使用了同样的材料再次施展该法术，则先前被监禁的生物立刻从禁锢中解脱摆脱恢复自由。
target:
• You create a magical prison to confine a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw and is imprisoned by this spell on a failure. If a creature succeeds on the save, it is immune to this spell if you cast it on that creature again. While imprisoned, the target does not need to breathe, eat, or drink and does not age. Divination spells cannot locate or perceive it. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following forms of imprisonment:
• Burial: The target is buried far beneath the surface inside a spherical field of magical force just large enough to contain it. Nothing can pass through the field, and no creature can enter or leave it by teleportation or planar travel. The special component is a small mithral sphere.
• Chaining: Heavy chains anchored firmly in the ground imprison the target in place. The target is restrained until the spell ends and cannot move or be moved by any means. The special component is a fine chain of precious metal.
• Hedged Prison: The spell transports the target to a small demiplane sealed against teleportation and planar travel. This demiplane can be a maze, a cell, a tower, or any confined structure or area you choose. The special component is a miniature jade prison.
• Minimus Containment: The target is shrunk to a height of 1 cun and confined inside a gemstone or similar object. Light passes through the gem normally, allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in, but nothing else can enter or leave, even through teleportation or planar travel. The gem cannot be cut or broken while the spell remains in effect. The special component is a large transparent gemstone, such as corundum, diamond, or ruby.
• Slumber: The target falls asleep and cannot be awakened. The special component is a rare soporific herb.
• Ending the Spell: Whichever form of the spell you use, you can specify during casting a condition that ends the spell and releases the target. You can make the condition as specific or complex as you wish, but the DM must agree that it is reasonable and achievable. The condition can be based on a creature's name, identity, or deity status, but otherwise must depend on observable actions or characteristics, rather than intangibles such as level, class, or hit points.
• Dispel Magic can end this spell only if cast using a level 9 spell slot and targeting the prison or the special material used to create the prison effect.
• You can create only one prison at a time using the same type of special component. If you cast this spell again using the same material, the previously imprisoned creature is immediately freed.
note: M507, Player's Handbook, level 9. All five prisons with their components, release-condition restrictions, dispel requirement, and repeat-material rule retained. Bare cun remains unconverted. The source alternates 'same type of special component' and 'same material'; this ambiguity is preserved, not narrowed to reuse of one specific physical item.

source: • 泉涌般的治愈能量从你流向你周围受伤的生物。你为施法距离内任意数量你能看见的生物恢复总计至多700点生命值，而具体治疗量则由你随意分配。受该法术所治疗的生物其所有疾病以及导致它们目盲或耳聋的效应也一并被治愈。该法术对不死生物和构装生物无效。
target: • A flood of healing energy flows from you to injured creatures around you. Restore up to 700 hit points in total to any number of creatures you can see within range, distributing the healing as you choose. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effects causing them to be blinded or deafened. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
note: M509, Player's Handbook, level 9. Preserves total rather than per-target healing, free allocation, sight/range, disease and condition-effect cures, and both excluded creature types.

source:
• 你可以转变施法距离内最多10个由你选择的可见生物。非自愿的目标必须通过一次感知豁免检定来对抗变形。非自愿的变形者（shapechanger）在这次豁免中自动成功。
• 每一个目标都获得由你选择的、相同或是不同的野兽形态。新的形态可以是你曾见过的、挑战等级低于或等于目标挑战等级任意野兽（如果目标没有挑战等级，那么上限是目标等级的一半）。这些目标的游戏数据，包括心智属性值，将被你所选择的野兽数据所取代，但仍然保留他们的生命值、阵营和人格。
• 每一个目标都得到等同于新形态生命值的临时生命值。这些临时生命值不能被其他来源的临时生命值替换。生物会在失去这些临时生命值或者死亡时变回原本的形态。如果法术在这之前结束，这些临时生命值也会失去且生物变回原形。
• 生物能进行的动作被它新形态的特质所限制。它将不能说话、施展法术、或是做其他需要用到手或言语的事情。
• 目标的装备融合进新形态，目标生物不能启动，使用，挥舞或其他方式从它的装备上获得增益。
context: column:M;spell:Mass Polymorph;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:9
target:
• You can transform up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the transformation. An unwilling shapechanger automatically succeeds on this save.
• Each target takes a beast form you choose, which can be the same as or different from the others' forms. The new form can be any beast you have seen whose challenge rating is no greater than the target's challenge rating, or half its level if it has no challenge rating. The target's game statistics, including its mental ability scores, are replaced by the chosen beast's statistics, but it retains its hit points, alignment, and personality.
• Each target gains temporary hit points equal to the hit points of its new form. These temporary hit points cannot be replaced by temporary hit points from another source. The creature returns to its original form when it loses these temporary hit points or dies. If the spell ends first, the temporary hit points are lost and the creature returns to its original form.
• The creature's actions are limited by the capabilities of its new form. It cannot speak, cast spells, or do anything else requiring hands or speech.
• The target's equipment merges into its new form. The creature cannot activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
note: M510, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 9. Complete CR/half-level limit, mental-stat replacement with retained HP, nonreplaceable temporary HP, all reversion conditions, action restrictions, and merged-equipment restrictions preserved.

source:
• 指定施法距离内四个你能看见的不同地点，并使熊熊燃烧的流星垂直坠落其地面。爆破的流星影响以指定点为中心，周边40尺半径的球状区域，区域影响会绕过拐角扩散。区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到20d6点火焰伤害和20d6点钝击伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。另外，同时处于多个爆炸范围内的生物仍只受一次效应影响。
• 该法术会对区域内的物件造成伤害，并点燃所有未被着装或携带的易燃物。
target:
• Choose four different locations you can see within range, and blazing meteors plunge vertically to the ground there. Each exploding meteor affects a sphere with a 40-foot radius centered on its chosen point, spreading around corners. Every creature in an affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A creature within more than one explosion is affected only once.
• The spell damages objects in the area and ignites all flammable objects that are not being worn or carried.
note: M511, Player's Handbook, level 9. Preserves four distinct visible sites, sphere radius, both damage rolls, successful-save halving, overlap limit, object damage, and ignition exclusion.

source: • 一波治疗能量覆盖你所触碰的生物，并使目标回复其所有的生命值。如果该生物正处于魅惑，惊惧，麻痹或震慑状态，则终止相应状态。如果该生物正处于倒地状态，则他可以执行其反应站起。该法术无法对不死生物和构装生物生效。
target: • A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you touch, restoring all its hit points. If the creature is charmed, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, those conditions end. If it is prone, it can use its reaction to stand up. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
note: M512, Player's Handbook, level 9. Preserves full healing, all four condition cures, optional reaction to stand, and both creature-type exclusions.

• 由光构成的闪光多彩平面形成一幅不透光的墙壁。墙壁垂直于地面，其至多长90尺，高30尺，厚1寸，并以施法距离内你能看见的一点为源点。你也可以将此墙塑造成一个直径至多30尺的球体，并以施法距离内你能看到的一点为中心。法墙在法术持续时间内维持在原地。如果定位法墙位置时可能使其穿过有生物占据的空间，则本次施法失败，而你的动作和法术位仍然会被浪费。
• 法墙延伸出100尺的明亮光照外加100尺的微光光照。你和施放该法术时指定的生物可以穿过法墙或停留在法墙附近而不受伤害。如果其他能看见法墙的生物移动到距墙20尺内区域或在该处开始其回合，则该生物必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败则陷入1分钟的目盲状态。
• 法墙由七层组成，每层都有不同颜色。生物试图进入或穿过法墙时，将一层层穿过法墙所有的光层。其每穿过一层就必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受下列光层特性影响。
• 法墙可以被摧毁，不过也必须由红到紫的顺序一次一个光层的通过具体每层。某个光层一旦被摧毁则其在法术持续时间内保持被摧毁状态。反魔法力场 Antimagic Field无法对法墙生效，法术解除魔法 Dispel Magic只对紫墙有效。
• 1.红 Red：生物豁免失败时受到10d6点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。此光层存在时，非魔法远程攻击无法穿过法墙。光层受至少25点冷冻伤害时被摧毁。
• 2.橙 Orange：生物豁免失败时受到10d6点强酸伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。此光层存在时，魔法远程攻击不能穿过法墙。光层受强风吹袭后被摧毁。
• 3.黄 Yellow：生物豁免失败时受到10d6点闪电伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。光层受至少60点力场伤害时被摧毁。
• 4.绿 Green：生物豁免失败时受到10d6点毒素伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。光层在受法术穿墙术 Passwall，或者其它相同或更高环阶法术在固态表面开口的效应影响时被摧毁。
• 5.蓝 Blue：生物豁免失败时受到10d6点冷冻伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。光层受至少25点火焰伤害时被摧毁。
• 6.靛 Indigo：生物豁免失败时受束缚。其每回合结束时进行一次体质豁免。三次豁免成功后法术终止。三次豁免失败后目标将永久陷入石化状态。成功或失败的豁免不需要连续，只需记下两边的数量直至其中一种达到三次。此光层存在时法术无法穿过。光层受昼明术 Daylight，或者其他相同或更高环阶法术发出的明亮光线照射时被摧毁。
• 7.紫 Violet：生物豁免失败时陷入目盲。其必须在你下一回合开始时进行一次感知豁免。豁免成功则目盲状态终止。豁免失败则该生物被传送到另一个DM指定的位面并且不再目盲。（典型情况是不在家乡位面的生物被驱逐回家，而其他生物通常会被传送到星界或以太位面。）该光层在受法术解除魔法 Dispel Magic，或者其他类似的相同或更高环阶法术所产生的终止法术魔法效应的影响时被摧毁。
target:
• A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms an opaque wall. The wall is vertical, up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 cun thick, originating at a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape it into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter, centered on a point you can see within range. The wall stays in place for the spell's duration. If placing the wall would make it pass through a space occupied by a creature, the casting fails, wasting your action and spell slot.
• The wall sheds bright light for 100 feet and dim light for another 100 feet. You and creatures you designate when casting the spell can pass through the wall or remain near it unharmed. If another creature that can see the wall moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw, becoming blinded for 1 minute on a failure.
• The wall consists of seven layers, each a different color. When a creature attempts to enter or pass through the wall, it passes through all the layers in sequence. It must make a Dexterity saving throw for each layer it passes through and is subject to that layer's properties below on a failure.
• The wall can be destroyed, but its layers must be overcome individually in order from red to violet. A destroyed layer remains destroyed for the spell's duration. Antimagic Field does not affect the wall, and Dispel Magic affects only the violet layer.
• 1. Red: On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 fire damage, or half as much on a success. While this layer exists, nonmagical ranged attacks cannot pass through the wall. The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 cold damage.
• 2. Orange: On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 acid damage, or half as much on a success. While this layer exists, magical ranged attacks cannot pass through the wall. A strong wind blowing against the layer destroys it.
• 3. Yellow: On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 lightning damage, or half as much on a success. The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 60 force damage.
• 4. Green: On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 poison damage, or half as much on a success. The layer is destroyed by Passwall, or by another spell of the same or a higher level that opens a passage through a solid surface.
• 5. Blue: On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 cold damage, or half as much on a success. The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 fire damage.
• 6. Indigo: On a failed save, the creature is restrained. It makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. After three successful saves, the spell ends. After three failed saves, the target becomes permanently petrified. The successes and failures need not be consecutive; track both totals until one reaches three. While this layer exists, spells cannot pass through it. The layer is destroyed by bright light from Daylight or another spell of the same or a higher level.
• 7. Violet: On a failed save, the creature is blinded. It must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the blindness ends. On a failure, the creature is transported to another plane chosen by the DM and is no longer blinded. Typically, a creature away from its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually sent to the Astral or Ethereal Plane. This layer is destroyed by Dispel Magic or a similar spell of the same or a higher level that ends spells or magical effects.
note: M514, Player's Handbook, level 9. All seven layers, damage/save branches, barriers, destruction requirements, and both wall shapes retained. Bare cun remains unconverted. Indigo literally says the spell ends after three successes, not just the condition; Violet checks at the start of your next turn. Both source formulations are preserved and flagged for source review.

source:
• 你释放你的心灵力量，轰击施法距离内至多10个由你选择的可见生物的心智。智力值为2或更低的生物不受影响。
• 每个目标都必须进行一次智力豁免检定。若豁免失败，目标受到14d6心灵伤害并且被震慑。豁免成功则只承受一半且不被震慑。如果一个有头的目标被这个伤害杀死，它的头会爆炸。
• 一个被震慑的生物可以在它每个回合结束时重新进行智力豁免。若豁免成功，震慑效果将结束。
context: column:M;spell:Psychic Scream;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:9
target:
• You unleash your psychic power to assault the minds of up to 10 creatures you choose and can see within range. Creatures with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected.
• Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 psychic damage and is stunned. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not stunned. If this damage kills a target that has a head, its head explodes.
• A stunned creature can repeat the Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the stunned effect on a success.
note: M515, Xanathar's Guide to Everything, level 9. Preserves inclusive target and Intelligence limits, damage/stun branches, conditional head explosion, and end-of-turn repeat saves.

source:
• 你以施法距离内你可见的一点为源点创造一个半径20尺的毁灭性球形力场。在法术持续时间内，球形力场与其100尺范围内的空间视为困难地形，且完全处于力场内的未被着装与携带的非魔法物件会被摧毁。
• 当力场出现时或者在你的每回合开始时，力场的100尺范围内未被着装的物件将被直直拉向力场的中心，并在距离力场中心最近的未被占据的空间停止。
• 当一个生物在力场的100尺范围内开始其回合时，其必须进行一个力量豁免，若失败则将被直直拉向力场的中心，并在距离力场中心最近的未被占据的空间停止。一个在当前回合内第一次进入力场的生物或在力场内开始其回合的生物会受到5d10点力场伤害并且被束缚，直到其离开力场范围。若力场位于空中，那么被束缚的生物将会在力场中悬浮。一个生物能以其动作进行一个对抗你的法术豁免DC的力量检定，若成功则能解除其自己或者另一个在其触及范围内的力场内的生物的束缚状态。若一个生物的HP被该法术降低至0，他与他身上携带的所有非魔法物件都会被湮灭。
target:
• You create a destructive spherical field of force with a 20-foot radius, originating at a point you can see within range. For the spell's duration, the sphere and the space within 100 feet of it are difficult terrain. Nonmagical objects entirely inside the sphere that are neither worn nor carried are destroyed.
• When the sphere appears and at the start of each of your turns, objects within 100 feet of the sphere that are not being worn are pulled straight toward its center, stopping in the nearest unoccupied space to the center.
• A creature that starts its turn within 100 feet of the sphere must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is pulled straight toward the sphere's center and stops in the nearest unoccupied space to the center. A creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside it takes 5d10 force damage and is restrained until it leaves the sphere. If the sphere is in the air, restrained creatures float inside it. A creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, ending the restrained condition on itself or another creature inside the sphere and within its reach on a success. If this spell reduces a creature's HP to 0, it and all nonmagical objects it is carrying are annihilated.
note: M516, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, level 9. The source excludes both worn and carried objects from automatic destruction, but excludes only worn objects from the pull; this distinction is preserved rather than adding an uncarried restriction. Damage, restrained duration, airborne suspension, escape check, and annihilation are complete.

source:
• 你在法术持续时间内变形为另一个生物。你的新形态可以是任何挑战等级小于等于你等级的生物。该类生物不能是构装生物或不死生物，而且你必须见过该类生物至少一次。你变形成该类生物中一个普通的个体，没有任何职业等级，也不具有施法特性。
• 你的游戏资料以目标生物的数据代替，但你的阵营，以及智力、感知和魅力值不变。你同样保留你的所有技能和豁免的熟练项，并且还能获得目标生物的技能和豁免的熟练项。如果目标生物和你都具有某熟练项，且目标生物在这该项的熟练加值比你高，则你在该项检定时使用较高的熟练加值而非自己的原加值。你不能使用新形态的传奇动作和巢穴动作。
• 你的生命值和生命骰变成和新形态一样。当你变回原形时，你的生命值恢复变形前的状态。如果你因为生命值降至0以下而变回原形，则你的正常形态将承受所有溢出的伤害。只要该伤害不足以把你在正常形态下的生命值也降至0，你就不会因此陷入昏迷。
• 你依然可以获得你的职业特性、种族特性和其他特性带来的增益，前提是你的新形态在物理上必须能够做到这些事。你不能使用任何之前享有的特殊感官（例如黑暗视觉），除非你的新形态也有这种感官。如果你变形成的生物通常不能说话，那么你也不能说话。
• 变形时，你可以选择你的装备掉到地上、融入新的形态中还是继续着装。继续着装的装备依然拥有正常情况下的功能。DM要根据新形态的外形和大小来判断你在新形态下是否能够继续着装你身上的每件装备。你的装备不会改变形状和尺寸以适应你的新形态，而新形态下不能着装的装备只能掉到地上或融入新的形态中。融入新形态的装备将不会产生任何效应。
• 在法术持续时间内，你可以用你的动作转换为另一形态。重新变形的规则与限制与第一次变形相同，只有一点不同：如果新形态的生命值比你当前的形态要多，那么你的生命值将保持为当前值不变。
target:
• You transform into another creature for the spell's duration. Your new form can be any creature whose challenge rating is no greater than your level. It cannot be a construct or undead, and you must have seen that kind of creature at least once. You become an ordinary member of that kind, without any class levels or the Spellcasting feature.
• Your game statistics are replaced by the creature's statistics, but your alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores remain unchanged. You also retain all your skill and saving throw proficiencies and gain the creature's skill and saving throw proficiencies. If both you and the creature have a proficiency, and the creature's proficiency bonus for it is higher than yours, use the higher bonus for that check instead of your original bonus. You cannot use the new form's legendary actions or lair actions.
• Your hit points and Hit Dice become those of the new form. When you return to your original form, your hit points return to their value before the transformation. If you revert because your hit points fall to 0 or lower, your normal form takes any excess damage. Unless that damage also reduces your normal form's hit points to 0, you do not fall unconscious as a result.
• You can still benefit from your class, racial, and other features, provided your new form is physically capable of using them. You cannot use any special senses you previously had, such as darkvision, unless the new form also has them. If the creature you become normally cannot speak, neither can you.
• When you transform, you choose whether your equipment falls to the ground, merges into the new form, or remains worn. Equipment that remains worn functions normally. The DM decides whether each piece can be worn in the new form, based on that form's shape and size. Your equipment does not change shape or size to fit the new form. Equipment that cannot be worn must fall to the ground or merge into the new form. Merged equipment has no effect.
• During the spell's duration, you can use your action to change into another form. The rules and restrictions are the same as for your first transformation, with one exception: if the new form has more hit points than your current form, your hit points remain at their current value.
note: M517, Player's Handbook, level 9. Complete form eligibility, retained mental statistics/proficiencies/features, HP and excess damage, equipment choices, and later transformations retained. The source explicitly compares proficiency bonuses; no alternative stat-block bonus interpretation was inserted.

• 一团翻腾搅动的乌云并以你能看见的一点为中心一直扩散至半径360尺的区域，并使该区域内充斥着电闪雷鸣与狂风呼啸。所有位于云团下的生物（处于云团下方5000尺内）必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到2d6点雷鸣伤害，并陷入持续5分钟的耳聋状态。
• 你每维持一轮该法术的专注，风暴就会在你的回合中产生新的效应：
• 第2轮：云层中降下酸雨。所有位于云团下方的生物和物件受到1d6点强酸伤害。
• 第3轮：你从云中召下六束闪电击向你指定的六个位于云团下的生物或物件，其中任一生物或物件都只能被该闪电击中一次。遭电击的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到10d6点闪电伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
• 第4轮：冰雹从云团中倾泻而下。所有位于云团下方的生物将受到2d6点钝击伤害。
• 第5－10轮：狂风和冰雨冲袭着云团下的区域，使该区域变为困难地形并造成重度遮蔽。该区域内的所有生物受到1d6点冷冻伤害。该区域内无法进行远程武器攻击。而其内的强风和暴雨将对维持法术专注造成严重干扰。此外，区域内的强风（风速在每小时20到50里）会自动吹散区域内的一切魔法或非魔法的烟雾以及其他类似现象。
target:
• A churning black storm cloud spreads over an area with a 360-foot radius centered on a point you can see, filling the area with lightning, thunder, and howling winds. Every creature beneath the cloud, within 5000 feet below it, must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 thunder damage and is deafened for 5 minutes.
• For each round that you maintain concentration on this spell, the storm produces a new effect on your turn:
• Round 2: Acid rain falls from the cloud. All creatures and objects beneath the cloud take 1d6 acid damage.
• Round 3: You call down six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six creatures or objects you choose beneath it. No creature or object can be struck more than once by this lightning. A creature struck must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 lightning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
• Round 4: Hail pours down from the cloud. All creatures beneath it take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
• Rounds 5–10: Strong winds and freezing rain batter the area beneath the cloud, making it difficult terrain and heavily obscured. All creatures in the area take 1d6 cold damage. Ranged weapon attacks cannot be made in the area. The strong winds and heavy rain seriously interfere with maintaining concentration on spells. In addition, the strong winds, at speeds of 20 to 50 li per hour, automatically disperse all magical and nonmagical fog and similar phenomena in the area.
note: M518, Player's Handbook, level 9. Complete initial save and rounds 2, 3, 4, and 5-10 effects preserved, including object versus creature distinctions. Bare li remains unconverted. The source only says concentration is seriously disrupted; no unstated DC or categorical concentration prohibition was added.

source: • 你选定一个施法距离内的目标，使他的身体形态受到飞速衰老的破坏。目标必须进行一个体质豁免并在豁免失败时受到12d10点黯蚀伤害, 或在豁免成功时只受到一半的伤害。若其豁免失败，目标还会快速老化至离老死只有三十天的时间点。在这个年龄段, 目标在攻击检定, 属性检定与豁免检定上承受劣势，其步行速度也减少一半。只有祈愿术Wish或以九环法术位施展的高等复原术Greater Restoration才能使这些效果消除并使其恢复原先的年龄。
target: • You choose a target within range and ravage its physical form with rapid aging. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 12d10 necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. On a failed save, the target also rapidly ages to the point where it has only thirty days left before dying of old age. At this age, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and its walking speed is halved. Only Wish or Greater Restoration cast using a ninth-level spell slot can remove these effects and restore its original age.
note: M519, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, level 9. The additional aging and penalties remain gated on a failed save. Thirty days and the ninth-level remedy are translated from written-out source numbers without introducing numeral changes.

source:
• 你使时间在除你之外所有生物的世界中暂时停止流动。你一次性进行1d4+1个回合，在这段过程内时间对于其他生物来说是静止的，但你可以像正常一样移动和使用动作。
• 在法术持续时间内，如果你的一个动作或任何你创造出来的效应影响到除你之外的任何生物，或影响到其他生物着装或携带的物件时，该法术将立即终止。此外，如果你在施法后移动离开施法位置超过1000尺，则法术也将因此终止。
target:
• You briefly stop the flow of time for every creature except yourself. You take 1d4+1 turns in succession. During that time, time stands still for other creatures, but you can move and take actions normally.
• The spell ends immediately if, during its duration, one of your actions or any effect you create affects any creature other than yourself, or an object another creature is wearing or carrying. The spell also ends if, after casting it, you move more than 1000 feet from the location where you cast it.
note: M520, Player's Handbook, level 9. Preserves the full 1d4+1 expression, action/effect termination alternatives, worn/carried objects, and strict more-than-1000-foot movement threshold.

source:
• 你指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物或物件并使其变形。你可以将目标生物变成另一个不同的生物，或将目标生物变成一个物件，又或者将目标物件变成一个生物（该物件必须没有被任何生物着装或携带）。变形效应持续到法术持续时间结束，或直至目标生命值降至0或目标死亡。如果你在法术持续时间内一直保持该法术的专注，则该变形得以永久持续。
• 该法术对变形生物以及生命值为0的目标无效。而不愿被变形的生物可以进行一次感知豁免，豁免成功则不受该法术影响。
• 生物变生物：如果你将一个生物变形成另一种生物，则它的新形态可以是你选择的挑战等级等于或低于受术者挑战等级（如果受术者没有挑战等级则按其角色等级）的任意物种。受术者的游戏资料（包括各精神属性值）将被新形态的数据取代，而其阵营和性格则保持不变。
  目标将使用新形态的生命值。而当其变回通常形态时，该目标的生命值也恢复为变形前的数值。如果目标是因为生命值降至0而变回通常形态，则由通常形态承受溢出的伤害。只要溢出伤害不足以将通常形态生命值降至0，他就不会因此而昏迷。
  该生物所能实施的行为因其新形态的特征而受限，除非其新形态的身体特征允许，否则该生物不能说话，施法或者执行任何需要手和言语的动作。
  目标的装备融入其新形态，而且不能激活或持用装备，也无法以其他任何方式从其装备上获益。
• 物件变生物：你可以将一个物件变成任何一种符合下列要求的生物：生物的体积不能大于原物件，且生物的挑战等级必须低于等于9。变形出的生物对你和你的同伴保持友善。而战斗中它将会在你的回合内，由你决定其如何行动。该生物的数据由DM掌控，并由DM来判定其行动结果如何。
  如果该法术变成永久有效，则你将不再控制该生物。此后，该生物将根据你对待他的方式决定是否对你保持友善。
• 生物变物件：如果你将一个生物变形成一个物件，则它连同其穿着携带物一起变成新的形态。受术者的数据变成和该物件一样，在法术终止而受术者变回原形后，它将不会记得在变成物件时所发生的任何事情。
target:
• You choose a creature or object you can see within range and transform it. You can turn a creature into a different creature, a creature into an object, or an object into a creature. An object being transformed must not be worn or carried by any creature. The transformation lasts until the spell's duration ends, the target drops to 0 hit points, or the target dies. If you maintain concentration throughout the spell's duration, the transformation becomes permanent.
• This spell has no effect on shapechangers or targets with 0 hit points. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, remaining unaffected on a success.
• Creature into Creature: If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, its new form can be any kind you choose whose challenge rating is no greater than the target's challenge rating, or its character level if it has no challenge rating. The target's game statistics, including its mental ability scores, are replaced by the new form's statistics, but it retains its alignment and personality.
  The target uses the new form's hit points. When it returns to its normal form, its hit points return to their value before the transformation. If it reverts because it drops to 0 hit points, its normal form takes any excess damage. Unless the excess damage reduces its normal form to 0 hit points, it does not fall unconscious as a result.
  The creature's actions are limited by its new form's characteristics. Unless that form is physically capable of doing so, it cannot speak, cast spells, or take any action requiring hands and speech.
  The target's equipment merges into its new form. It cannot activate or wield the equipment or benefit from it in any other way.
• Object into Creature: You can turn an object into any creature meeting both of these requirements: the creature must be no larger than the original object, and its challenge rating must be no greater than 9. The transformed creature is friendly to you and your companions. In combat, it acts on your turn, and you decide what it does. The DM has its statistics and determines the results of its actions.
  If the spell becomes permanent, you no longer control the creature. Afterward, it decides whether to remain friendly to you according to how you have treated it.
• Creature into Object: If you turn a creature into an object, it and everything it is wearing or carrying take the new form. Its statistics become those of the object. When the spell ends and it returns to its original form, it has no memory of what happened while it was an object.
note: M521, Player's Handbook, level 9. All three transformation modes and subparagraphs retained, including HP overflow, merged equipment, size/CR limits, control, and object memory. Uses the source's permanent-duration wording rather than silently importing a later erratum or another edition.

• 你触碰一个已死的生物使其复活。该生物的死亡时间必须不超过200年，且死因不能是老死。如果该生物的灵魂愿意并且能够回到其身体中，则它将以生命值全满的状态复活。
• 该法术能治愈所有致命伤，中和一切毒素与疾病，并解除其生前所受的一切诅咒。该法术甚至能恢复其损伤或失去的器官和肢体。
• 如果受术生物的遗体已经不再存在，该法术甚至能给它再造一个新的身体。此时，你必须喊出该生物的名字，随后该生物便出现在你指定点周围10尺内一处未被占据的空间。
target:
• You touch a dead creature and bring it back to life. It must have been dead for no more than 200 years and must not have died of old age. If its soul is willing and able to return to its body, it returns to life with all its hit points.
• This spell closes all mortal wounds, neutralizes all poisons and diseases, and removes all curses that affected the creature before its death. It can even restore damaged or missing organs and limbs.
• If the creature's remains no longer exist, the spell can create a new body for it. In that case, you must call out the creature's name, and it appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of a point you choose.
note: M522, Player's Handbook, level 9. Preserves age/death/soul conditions and all repairs. For a new body, the source locates arrival within 10 feet of a chosen point, not necessarily the caster; that wording remains unchanged.

source: • 你利用一群生物最恐惧的事物，在它们的心中创造出一个只有它们自己能看见的虚幻生物。指定施法距离内一点为中心，其周边半径30尺球状区域内的所有生物必须进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败者将在法术终止前陷入恐慌。该法术造出的幻像能唤起受术者心中最深的恐惧，使它最恐怖的噩梦显现为一个永远无法摆脱的威胁。如果生物因该法术陷入恐慌，则它在自己每回合结束时必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则受到4d10点心灵伤害。豁免成功则此法术在该生物身上的效应终止。
target: • Drawing on a group of creatures' deepest fears, you create an illusory creature in their minds that only they can see. Choose a point within range. Every creature in a sphere with a 30-foot radius centered on that point must make a Wisdom saving throw, becoming frightened until the spell ends on a failure. The illusion awakens each target's deepest fears, manifesting its worst nightmare as a threat it can never escape. A creature frightened by this spell must make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 4d10 psychic damage on a failure. On a successful save, the spell's effect ends on that creature.
note: M523, Player's Handbook, level 9. Complete initial frightened save, visible-only-to-target illusion, end-of-turn damage save, and individual termination retained.

source:
• 祈愿术是凡间生物所能施展的最强大法术。你只需要大声说出自己的愿望就能将现实世界的根基操弄于手中。
• 此法术最基础的用法是用来模仿任意一个8环或更低环阶的法术。你不需要满足目标法术所需的任何前提条件（包括昂贵的材料成分）就可以让该法术生效。
• 除此之外，你也可以选择创造下列效应其中之一：
→你创造出一个价值不超过25,000gp的物件。该物件不能是魔法物品。该物件最长尺寸不能超过300尺，并随法术出现在地面上你能看见的一处未被占据位置。
→你让至多二十个你能看见的生物恢复其全部生命值，并且终止
它们身上一切在高等复原术 Greater Restoration中描述过的效应。
→你让至多十个你能看见的生物对你所指定的一种伤害类型具有抗性
→你让最多十个你能看见的生物在八小时内免疫某种法术或其他魔法效应。例如，你可以使你自己和你的所有同伴免疫巫妖的吸取生命。
→你改变一件刚刚发生的事件。重掷前一轮的任意一次掷骰（包括你前一回合进行的掷骰），并让现实随着你的新掷骰结果改变。例如，祈愿术 Wish可以撤销对手的成功豁免，敌人的重击或同伴的失败豁免。你可以迫使重新进行的掷骰具有优势或劣势，并且可以选择是使用重投后的结果还是使用原来的结果。
• 上述范例效应之外，你也许还能达成其他某些结果。你可以详细的跟DM说明你的愿望，并由DM对其作出判定。不过你的愿望越大，出错的概率就越大。法术可能会直接失败，也可能部分的达成你想要的结果，你还有可能因表述愿望时措辞不当而遭到意想不到的结果。例如，许愿让一个坏人死去可能会让你穿越到多年后该人已死的一个时间段，使你相当于离开了游戏一样。此外，许愿获取一件传说中的魔法物品或神器可能会立即将你传送到该物品当前的持有者身边。
• 施放该法术来达成除了模仿其他法术外的任何目的都会使你承受极大的负担。承受这种负担之后，直到你完成一次长休息之前，你每次施放法术时都将受到一定伤害（伤害数值与施放法术的环阶相关，每环1d10点黯蚀伤害）。你无法以任何方式减轻或防止这种伤害，而你的力量值在也将在2d4日内降至3（除非它已经是3或更低）。在这段时间里，你每花一整日休息（不从事任何费力的工作），恢复需要的日数就减少2日。最后，如果你承受了这种负担，你将有33%的概率再也无法施放祈愿术。
target:
• Wish is the most powerful spell a mortal creature can cast. Merely speaking your desire aloud lets you manipulate the foundations of reality.
• The spell's most basic use is to duplicate any spell of level 8 or lower. You do not need to meet any of that spell's requirements, including costly material components, to make it take effect.
• Alternatively, you can choose to produce one of the following effects:
→You create an object worth no more than 25,000 gp. It cannot be a magic item. Its longest dimension cannot exceed 300 feet. It appears on the ground in an unoccupied location you can see.
→You restore all hit points to up to twenty creatures you can see and end every effect on them described in Greater Restoration.
→You grant up to ten creatures you can see resistance to one damage type you choose.
→You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a particular spell or other magical effect for eight hours. For example, you can make yourself and all your companions immune to a lich's Life Drain.
→You change an event that just occurred. Reroll any roll made in the previous round, including one you made on your previous turn, and reality changes to match the new result. For example, Wish can undo an opponent's successful save, an enemy's critical hit, or a companion's failed save. You can force the reroll to have advantage or disadvantage and choose whether to use the new result or the original result.
• You might achieve results beyond the example effects above. Describe your wish to the DM in detail, and the DM determines what happens. The greater the wish, however, the greater the chance of something going wrong. The spell might fail outright, achieve only part of what you want, or produce an unexpected result because of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing for a villain to die might transport you to a time many years later when that person is already dead, effectively removing you from the game. Wishing to acquire a legendary magic item or artifact might immediately transport you to its current owner.
• Casting this spell for any purpose other than duplicating another spell places a tremendous strain on you. After suffering this strain, each time you cast a spell before finishing a long rest, you take damage according to that spell's level: 1d10 necrotic damage per level. This damage cannot be reduced or prevented in any way. Your Strength also drops to 3 for 2d4 days, unless it is already 3 or lower. During that time, each full day you spend resting without strenuous activity reduces the remaining recovery time by 2 days. Finally, if you suffer this strain, there is a 33% chance that you can never cast Wish again.
note: M524, Player's Handbook, level 9. Full duplication use, all five alternative effects, DM-adjudication examples, and every strain consequence retained. The longest-dimension limit follows the source. Joins the accidental line break inside the Greater Restoration bullet; does not change numbered values or written-out creature/time limits.
